about: Three sessions copied in a row, ids A < B < W. W makes one call (1 input token; the other kinds ten, a hundred and a thousand times that) and ends at minute 1. A resumes W at minute 10, its copy keeping W's id, and makes a call at minute 11 (2) and one at minute 100 (8). B forks A at minute 20, its copy of everything renamed to B, and makes one call (4). Collected at minute 100, when A is still open and B is closed, then again once A is closed. Counted once: 15 in all; W 1, A 8, and B 6, the call A made at minute 11 included, because B ended first.
